newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung says target of U.S. patent suit.
newsitem.headline: Samsung says target of U.S. patent suit.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co said on Tuesday that it and two of its units in the United States have been named as defendants in a suit alleging that the companies had infringed patents regarding liquid crystal display (LCD) technology.
Its two U.S. units are Samsung Electronics America Inc and Samsung Semiconductor Inc, the company said in a statement.
The statement said that Semiconductor Energy Laboratory Co of Japan filed the suit on October 10 at an Alexandria, Virginia district court alleging that the firms had infringed on three LCD patents.
"Samsung will do its best to prove its innocence because the three property rights issues are null and void," the statement said, without giving further details.
"Samsung expects any effect from the dispute to be very minimal."
The suit is seeking acknowledgement of wrongdoing, an immediate halt to the infringement, and compensation for damages, it said.
Samsung Electronics, the flagship of Samsung Group, did not reveal the amount of compensation that was being sought. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5644
